description: This PHP file defines the CoreExtension class for the Twig templating engine, providing core filter, function, and test definitions, node parsers, operator precedence, and attribute access logic for Twig templates.

classes.name: CoreExtension
classes.description: Defines core functionality for Twig extensions including filters, functions, operators, and attribute access methods.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the default date format and interval format used by Twig.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the current default date formats.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone for date formatting.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Gets the current default timezone.

methods.name: setNumberFormat
methods.description: Sets the default number formatting parameters.

methods.name: getNumberFormat
methods.description: Gets the current number formatting parameters.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array of token parsers used by Twig.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of custom filters provided by this extension.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of custom functions provided by this extension.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an array of tests available in Twig.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array of node visitors (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Defines the operator precedence and associativity for Twig expressions.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Cycles over a sequence, returning the value at a given position, wrapping around as needed.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Returns a random value from a sequence, string, or number.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date or interval according to the specified format.

methods.name: modifyDate
methods.description: Returns a date modified by a given interval.

methods.name: sprintf
methods.description: Returns a formatted string using sprintf syntax.

methods.name: dateConverter
methods.description: Converts a date using the environment's extension.

methods.name: convertDate
methods.description: Converts various date representations to \\DateTime or \\DateTimeImmutable.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs string replacements.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number using specified method.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number according to locale settings.

methods.name: urlencode
methods.description: URL-encodes a string or array.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges multiple arrays or traversables.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Slices an array, traversable, or string.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first element of a collection.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last element of a collection.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins elements into a string with specified separators.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array based on a delimiter.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Returns the value or a default if empty.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Gets the keys of an array or Traversable.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses a string, array, or Traversable.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly shuffles a string, array, or Traversable.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of a variable.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase.

methods.name: striptags
methods.description: Removes HTML/PHP tags from a string.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of a string.

methods.name: callMacro
methods.description: Calls a macro within a template (deprecated in 4.0).

methods.name: ensureTraversable
methods.description: Ensures a variable is traversable.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a sequence or traversable to an array.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a variable is empty.

methods.name: testSequence
methods.description: Tests if a variable is a sequence.

methods.name: testMapping
methods.description: Tests if a variable is a mapping.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes a sub-template and renders it.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source code of a template.

methods.name: enumCases
methods.description: Returns all cases of an enum.

methods.name: enum
methods.description: Returns a specific enum case.

methods.name: constant
methods.description: Gets the value of a constant.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Splits an array into batches.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Accesses an attribute (property or method) of an object or array.

methods.name: convertDate
methods.description: Converts various date representations to \DateTime or \DateTimeImmutable.
